d:
'Luka Chuppi' from 'Rang De Basanti', an emotional ride into the life of a mother, enacted by Waheeda Rehman, who lost her son, enacted by R. Madhavan, while he was serving India, his country. The video features Aamir Khan, Siddharth Narayan, Sharman Joshi, Kunal Kapoor and Soha Ali Khan, all very emotional as they say good bye to their friend. This moive will awaken the patriot in you. This beautiful patriotic drama is directed by Rakeysh Omprakash Mehra and the music is directed by music maestro A.R. Rahman.
Song Name - Luka Chuppi
Movie - Rang De Basanti
